**q25** — Engine: Google CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`, `go.mod:13`) wrapped by the in-repo `internal/filter` package (`engine.go:24` `NewEngine`, `Compile` :46; schema `schema.go`, IR `ir.go`, SQL rendering `render.go`). Mechanism: the CEL expression is compiled into a dialect-agnostic condition tree (IR), which `render.go` renders to a parameterized SQL fragment per dialect (`DialectSQLite`/`DialectPostgres`/`DialectMySQL`, e.g. `render.go:231-237`); each driver calls `filter.DefaultEngine()` + `filter.AppendConditions(..., filter.DialectXxx, &where, &args)` when building its query (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57,61`, and the postgres/mysql equivalents).

**q26** — `memo` (the memo row plus each comment memo row), `memo_relation` (both `memo_id` and `related_memo_id` sides), `attachment` (rows for attachments linked to the memo, plus their stored blobs/files), and `memo_share` via the DB-level `FOREIGN KEY … ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/postgres/LATEST.sql:108`, `mysql/LATEST.sql:108`, `sqlite/LATEST.sql:109` — note SQLite opens with `_pragma=foreign_keys(0)`, `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go:53`, so the cascade is not enforced there). `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but are **not** deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:546-551`).

**q27** — Mechanism: the Vite build output is compiled into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA fallback. File: `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21` (embed), `:40-60` (`Serve`, static + `spaFallbackMiddleware`); wired in `server/server.go:70`.

**q28**
```
s3presign runner — RunOnce at startup, then a 12-hour time.Ticker (server/server.go:162-169; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:26,29-41)
```
Unused-infra note: `server/runner/memopayload` exposes a `Runner` with `RunOnce` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:19,27`) but is never instantiated by the server — only its `RebuildMemoPayload` helper (:74) is used inline. Likewise `internal/scheduler`, a full cron-expression scheduler with middleware (`internal/scheduler/doc.go`, `scheduler.go`), is referenced only by its own tests — no production code imports it.

**q29** — Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:148-172` (installed on the Connect transport at :180). Tokens: a short-lived **access token** kept in `localStorage` and sent as `Authorization: Bearer …` (`web/src/auth-state.ts:6,52,78`), and a **refresh token** in an HttpOnly cookie `memos_refresh` sent via `credentials: "include"` (`web/src/connect.ts:57-62`; cookie name `server/auth/token.go:49`), refreshed through `AuthService.RefreshToken` on 401 or pre-expiry. Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`authenticator.go`, `token.go`, `extract.go`), driven by the shared `Authorizer` (`server/router/api/v1/authz.go`) used by both the gateway middleware and the Connect `NewAuthInterceptor` (`server/router/api/v1/v1.go:66-137`); personal access tokens are also accepted (`server/auth/authenticator.go:159` → `Store.GetUserByPATHash`).
